reflections.summary: Fix classifier rule (keep 一份/一个 as :quant+:unit), title marks as name tokens, but-91 :ARG1/:ARG2, 由于→:reason, 以X而Y→:reason, non-core role rules (:place for countries, :medium, :part-of, adverbs as :mod, shared modifiers on conjuncts, no invented arguments, 属 argument order), habitual/state/performance aspect rules, have-degree-91 for superlatives and chengyu as :mod, temporal rules (no parent for identity/modifier states, chain to main event, 目前 depends on DCT), same-event only with same participants; add Examples section.

Temporal: parent-first and one-parent rule; every aspect-bearing event gets a parent; main event to DCT; vague present adverbs get no triple (main event depends-on DCT); corrected example. Aspect: -91 predicates are state plus modal; stative verbs stay state with 过; 已经 main predicate is performance. Implicit arguments: V1V2的N chain, :part-of only with written owner, no copied subjects, 其中 as :mod. No :wiki; no coref for modifier place names; inner and for nouns without 、. Examples added.

Add N1+V+N2 procedure compound rule (identity-91) and its temporal parent; restrict English entity types to named nodes/pronouns; have-degree-91 has no aspect/temporal/modal; resolve :before vs :depends-on for main events; 以…而闻名 → (闻名 :contained 发行); 曾经 → :temporal; 未经 without :polarity -; examples.

Fix temporal labels (date/purpose -> overlap, reason -> before, earlier participle -> before), cross-sentence anchoring for result sentences, reify sentence-level reason/purpose as have-reason-91/have-purpose-91, 版面 :part-of and relative :ARG0-of clauses, appositive identity-91, individual-person and -人 agent nouns, 发行量 + have-quant-91 pattern, restrict but-91 to intra-sentence, :era for decades, :manner on event nouns, new aspect rules, checklist no-invented-args, examples.

Clause-level vs NP-internal -91/-92 aspect/modal; no aspect on 发行 under 量; event nouns as arguments keep sense (fix 黑白印刷 example); entity full node at first textual mention, 版面 :part-of only; no node for prepositions before dates.

Dates depend on document-creation-time (not root); first-mention full node enforced via 2.5 note and checklist step; general Chinese PropBank ARG0-theme warning and 量 :ARG0 of 达到/跌; examples; trimmed obsolete :wiki note.

Fix 虽然+不过 → but-91; 以X为目的 → identity-91; 是Adj的 → have-mod-91; parenthetical gloss → identity-91; first lady → have-rel-role-91; re-entrancy only for pronouns (repeated nouns get own node + :same-entity), 他们 for org; names (·, category noun before foreign name, planet); :quote rule; 有关系 → 有-03 with and; 后来 → consecutive; listing 有 → :example; :frequency; 出现 roles; 其中+superlative → :ARG5 + implicit-argument; compound lookup first; aspect for nouns under 停止/继续, 生存 state, resultative performance; no triples for non-events. Trimmed intro and redundant examples to fit size.

Temporal: restrict :depends-on, past-topic claims/habits/evaluations :before, conjunct chaining, reported -91 content has no temporal triple and inner events chain from the reporting verb. Modal: claim content gets author+speaker triples. Names listed as example characters are individual-person with the category noun as :op1. :quote on each conjunct, 等 as last :opN, no ARG0 from 他们的 in a claim. Aspect of claims/generic activities, 前第一夫人, 仍/都 no node, shared date re-entered. Trimmed redundant text to fit.

Modal: forbid author→null-conceiver triple; agentless report verbs (被指) take the reported clause's subject (and-node) as conceiver. 其中最X宗 → have-degree-91 :ARG1 大 :ARG2 最 :ARG5 其中 with bare 大. Narrow adverb rule (no 仍 before 继续, no 都 in 都以…为目的); sentence-initial date shared by but-91/and clauses. 一些 → :quant. Speaker triple on 报导 in 不过 clause. Trimmed redundant examples and type list for space.

Headlines in 「」 as publication :name; named events/building names; Chinese adjectives with rolesets as ARG0-of events, X者/V人 splitting; narrower adverb-node rule (甚至, additive 还/也); 靠→:reason, 有能力→有-06+identity-91, :part-of for publication content, :topic, :place-of; modal: reporter conceives its own reporting acts, no modal on connectives or nested args, entity author triples only for conceivers; temporal chaining of 3+ conjuncts and reported past events under the reporting verb; no coref of generic nouns. Trimmed redundant examples and conflicting checklist lines for space.

Fix modal convention for reporting (speaker conceives report verbs, content author-only, complement 当 no modal), headline-after-noun identity-91, sentence-initial 为了 → bare have-reason-91 with re-entered subject, 美国的N → :possessor, temporal parents for noun modifiers/nested reasons/argument conjunctions, time-clause reuse only for dates, :quote on nested events, no 也 in reported content, 如/例如 → have-example-91, ability VP neutral-affirmative; freed space by removing the English demo graph and duplicate items.

Noun-modifying verbs become ARG1-of events (合成照片); -00 for defective/mismatched rolesets; 在-phrase fills a roleset location arg; speaker conceives 报导 only with reported content; :quote on 报导 for 「」 content; 全世界 split; argument-level and conjuncts take the governing event as temporal parent. Trimmed redundant text and examples for space.
